array.string: export AGENT_SYSTEM_ENV_FILE="../.env" AGENT_SYSTEM_RUNTIME_KIND="launchd"; if [[ ! -r "$AGENT_SYSTEM_ENV_FILE" ]]; then echo "required config source is missing: $AGENT_SYSTEM_ENV_FILE" >&2; exit 78; fi; set -a; source "$AGENT_SYSTEM_ENV_FILE"; set +a; export DASHBOARD_JWT_SECRET="$( <data/.dashboard_jwt_secret)" && exec ./venv/bin/uvicorn main_slim_v2:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3021
